close_reason: Implemented option (a) from the bead: added AssessmentResultsOptions struct (with Default returning the documented placeholder, plus with_import_ap_href builder) and assessment_results_with_options entry point. Bare assessment_results stays as a thin wrapper using default options. Operators wiring real OSCAL toolchains can now override import-ap.href to a real Assessment Plan URI. Two regression tests lock both paths. New type added to Send+Sync compile-time assertion block. 302 tests pass; workspace builds clean.
description:
pkix-lint/src/oscal/emit.rs:170-175 hardcodes import-ap.href = '#assessment-plan-placeholder'. The comment says 'Real deployments override.' but the public API offers no override slot — the assessment_results() function takes only an EvaluationReport.

Failure mode: every consumer who emits OSCAL with this crate and passes the output through a real OSCAL toolchain (oscal-cli validate, Trestle, etc.) will get a validation failure on day one. The first one to hit it will file a 'pkix-lint emits invalid OSCAL' bug, and the fix is either (a) add an emit_with_options builder, (b) document loudly that callers MUST post-edit the returned Value, or (c) accept that this is a half-built emitter not ready for downstream validators.

Maintainer consequence: this is a class of issue reports waiting to be filed. The bd tracker should record it before it gets reported externally. Pick one: a) ship the option, b) put a #[deprecated(since=..)] on the bare function until an emit_with_options ships, or c) add a panicking debug_assert that an override env var is set so devs hit it locally.
title: OSCAL assessment_results emits placeholder import-ap.href that produces invalid OSCAL by default
